faq.q: Are you an agent, a consultant or a distributor?
faq.a: An agent. We never take title to stock. We read the market, register your products, appoint the importer, run promotion and state bids, and report weekly.
On results: commission on sales, agreed per market before anything starts. There is no fee for introductions.

faq.q: Whose name is on the registration?
faq.a: Yours. Registrations are always held in the manufacturer's name. We act as your local representative and are never the holder.

faq.q: Do we need an EAEU GMP certificate?
faq.a: It depends on the route. For the EAEU route the plant is inspected by the Kazakh inspectorate. We check your plant's position for each route on the first call, before you spend anything on a dossier.

faq.q: We already have a distributor in that market.
faq.a: Then we look at whether they are the right one. Because the registration is yours, the importer can always be replaced.
Typically 12–24 months after filing, depending on the market and the route.

faq.q: What do you need from us to start?
faq.a: Your product list with dosage forms and strengths, and your certificates. Dossiers come later, and only for the products you take forward.

faq.q: Is my product list kept confidential?
faq.a: Yes. It is used to read the market for you and nothing else.
All 14 markets we serve. Kazakhstan is the one we show in full on this site; every market gets the same read.
People, using our own software. You are not buying a login: our team does the work and you get the result, weekly.

faq.q: What do you need from us?
faq.a: One person for about a week at the start: your catalogue, supplier list, markets and priorities. After that, a weekly read and a call when a decision is needed.
It is used for your partnership only. Not pooled, not resold, not used for anyone else. This is written into the agreement.
